# index: `IndexManifest`

The `data` payload of `openreadout index DIR -o INDEX_DIR --json` (also `INDEX_DIR/index.json`), inside the [envelope](envelope.md).

`index.json`.

JSON Schema: [`docs/schema/index.schema.json`](https://github.com/openreadout/openreadout/blob/main/docs/schema/index.schema.json) · also printed by `openreadout self schema index`.

### CrawlStats

Counters of one crawl (cumulative over resumed sessions of the same run).

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Walk items processed: files and directory data sets. |
| `files_seen` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Files seen, counting every file inside directory data sets. |
| `recognised` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Items a reader recognised (before multi-file grouping). |

| `unreadable` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Recognised items that could not be opened or summarized. |

| `changed` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Items read again (size, time or tool version changed). |
| `unchanged` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Items reused from the previous run without being opened. |

| `bytes_seen` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Bytes of every file seen. |
| `bytes_read` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Bytes the crawler itself read (sniffing and fingerprints); the readers' own header reads are not counted. |
